parameters.name: AccountLockState
parameters.description:
The lock status of the account. Valid values:

- **UnLock**: The account is not locked.

- **Lock**: The account is locked.

parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the database account.

parameters.name: AccountPasswordValidTime
parameters.description: The expiration time of the account. The time must be in the \`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ\` format.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view the details of all clusters in a region, including cluster IDs.
